newsitem.title: INDIA: Airforce plane crashes in India, 22 killed.
newsitem.headline: Airforce plane crashes in India, 22 killed.

text.p: An Indian Air Force plane crashed in the southern Indian state of Andhra Pradesh on Tuesday and all 22 people on board were killed, the air force and police said.

Police said the British-made Avro, with 16 members of an air force brass band and six crew members, crashed in a field near Nellore town after taking off from Madras, the capital of the neighbouring state of Tamil Nadu, they said.
Nellore is 150 km (90 miles) north of Madras.
Bodies and military equipment were strewn around the site of the crash, officials said.
The aircraft was bound for Hyderabad, state capital of Andhra Pradesh.

The Press Trust of India news agency said one of the airplane's engines failed and the pilot reported the problem to air traffic control (ATC) authorities in Madras. The aircraft then hit a hill and crashed in a field.
